press_references.value: Ambience Healthcare Expands Chart-Aware Intelligence to Full Inpatient Workflow

product_launches.description: Ambience Healthcare launched an expanded version of its chart-aware intelligence across the full inpatient workflow, adding capabilities like Patient Summary, enhanced H&P and progress notes, diagnoses support, hospital stay summaries, and one-click discharge summaries for hospitalists.

press_references.value: Ambience Healthcare Launches Chart Chat for Nursing, the First EHR-Integrated Conversational AI Tool for Inpatient Nursing

product_launches.description: Ambience Healthcare launched Chart Chat for Nursing, an EHR-integrated conversational AI tool that lets inpatient nurses query patient records in plain language with citation-backed answers, initially piloted at Cleveland Clinic.

press_references.value: Ambience Healthcare Expands “Chart Awareness” Across Its Intelligence Platform

product_launches.description: Ambience Healthcare expanded and rolled out new chart-aware capabilities across its AI platform, including patient summaries, assessment & plan, diagnostics, and coding features to enhance clinical decision support and revenue integrity.

press_references.value: Ambience Healthcare Launches AI-Powered “Conditions Advisor” to Support Comprehensive Inpatient Documentation and High-Quality Care

product_launches.description: Ambience Healthcare launched Conditions Advisor, an AI capability for inpatient workflows that analyzes full patient records to surface evidence for secondary diagnoses, improving documentation accuracy and care coordination aligned with AHIMA/ACDIS standards.

press_references.value: Vendor notebook: Health IT companies put data challenges in focus

product_launches.description: Ambience Healthcare launched a real-time CDI platform, HCC Compliance Validator, to validate diagnoses at the point of care across EHRs like Epic and athenahealth, reducing CMS audit risk.

press_references.value: Ambience Healthcare Unveils Chart Chat: The First AI Copilot Built Into the EHR

product_launches.description: Ambience Healthcare has launched Chart Chat, an AI copilot integrated into Epic's EHR system, providing real-time, patient-specific clinical insights and decision support for healthcare providers.

press_references.value: Ambience Healthcare's AI Platform Surpasses Clinician Performance by 27% in Medical Coding, Powered by New OpenAI Breakthrough

product_launches.description: Ambience Healthcare has launched a new AI model for medical coding that surpasses board-certified physicians in ICD-10 coding accuracy by 27%, leveraging OpenAI's Reinforcement Fine-Tuning technology. The platform aims to reduce coding errors and administrative waste in healthcare.

press_references.value: Is Medical Terminology Software Becoming the Backbone of Modern Healthcare Systems?

product_launches.description: Ambience Healthcare launched an OpenAI-powered engine in May 2025 that improved medical coding accuracy during pilot testing and plans broader rollout.

press_references.value: Ambience Healthcare’s AI Platform for Documentation, CDI, and Coding Now Available in Microsoft Azure Marketplace

product_launches.description: Ambience Healthcare has launched its AI platform for clinical documentation, CDI, and coding in the Microsoft Azure Marketplace, enabling health systems to access and deploy the solution through Azure's cloud ecosystem.

overview_description.description: Ambience Healthcare develops an AI operating system used for documentation, coding, and clinical workflows in healthcare settings. The company builds an AI medical scribe that captures clinician-patient conversations in real time and converts them into clinical notes. Its scribe tool includes speech recognition, real-time documentation, and AI features designed to integrate with electronic medical record systems. The tool generates notes within seconds and allows customization based on user preferences.

about_short_description.short_description: Ambience Healthcare develops an AI operating system used for documentation, coding, and clinical workflows in healthcare organizations.

product.name: Ambience Healthcare AI Platform
product.description: An AI platform for real-time clinical documentation, chart review, workflow support, and coding across ambulatory, inpatient, and emergency care settings.

product.name: Coding & Compliance Engine
product.description: An AI engine that translates clinical documentation into supported ICD-10, CPT, HCC, and E/M coding recommendations while validating compliance and audit readiness.

product.name: Ambulatory Care Solution
product.description: A clinical AI workflow solution for outpatient visits that supports pre-visit chart review, ambient note creation, patient communications, and coding assistance.

product.name: Inpatient Care Solution
product.description: An AI solution for hospital care that generates admission, daily progress, consult, and discharge documentation from the patient record and bedside encounters.

product.name: Emergency Department Solution
product.description: An AI documentation and coding solution designed for fast-paced emergency care, including encounter transcription, ED medical decision-making, procedure capture, and critical-care coding support.

product.name: Clinical Intelligence for Nurses
product.description: A clinical intelligence capability that provides nurses with patient context, care guidance, and hospital-protocol information at the point of care.
